package.name: openarmx_ptp_box_align_msgs
package.description: Action interface for openarmx_ptp_box_align: consume detected boxes, assign each to the nearer arm (by base-frame Y), and move the assigned arm's link7 above its box at a commanded height and hand orientation via a direct Pinocchio IK + single-endpoint joint_trajectory_controller move (no QP/CBF, no MoveIt).
